answer: Sequential Work Ledger: identities earn standing only by completing verified micro-tasks in sequence, each task's output checked against a random peer's prior result. A violet audit flag marks any ledger whose task timing is impossibly uniform. New identities start in a shared haven queue with capped throughput, so reach scales linearly with elapsed verified work, not registrations. An attacker farming N sybils must fund N parallel work histories, each consuming real labor-hours and held in a meadow of deprioritized slots until cleared.
